summary: Iteration 57 — Infrastructure Phase B (Automatic Replacement) FULL end-to-end verification PASSED. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_infra_phase_b.py with 7 pytest cases covering all 4 endpoints + the user-confirmed rules. All 7 PASS (1.02s, 100%): (1) GET /candidate/{id} returns replacement candidate while EXCLUDING any account currently assigned to a running campaign/drip (busy-pool rule proven by seeding a separate camp_c on a healthy account C and asserting C is NOT picked); (2) GET /candidate cross-domain preference verified — paused account on example.com → replacement on a different domain when one exists, cross_domain flag accurately reflects domain comparison; (3) GET /candidate 404 on unknown account; (4) POST /execute/{id} swaps account_ids in BOTH camp_a and drip_a in DB (Mongo verified), logs row in tracked_replacements with status=completed, triggered_by=manual, cross_domain field, campaigns_swapped & drips_swapped arrays; unrelated camp_c account_ids untouched; (5) POST /execute 404 on unknown account; (6) GET /replacements returns {items, counts, total} with by_status + by_trigger counts, descending by created_at; status= and triggered_by= filters narrow correctly (verified by injecting synthetic no_candidate row); (7) POST /auto-scan returns {scanned, candidates, completed[], no_candidate[]} with correct shape. Frontend (browser_automation against https://routemail-demo.preview.emergentagent.com via Mongo-injected session token TEST_iter57ui_*): (a) /infrastructure renders infra-replacement-section with all 4 bucket cards (rep-atrisk=1 / rep-logged / rep-completed / rep-nocand), rep-scan-btn, rep-history-link, rep-atrisk-list containing the seeded paused account; (b) rep-row-replace-acc_c64869233e32 click opened replace-dialog → replace-confirm click POSTed execute and the dialog closed (DB shows campaign account_ids rewritten from acc_c64869233e32 → new replacement); (c) all 19 inbox-replace-btn-<account_id> icons present on Inbox Activity table — first one opens the same replace-dialog; (d) /infrastructure/replacements page renders back-to-infra, rep-auto-scan-btn, rep-filter-status, rep-filter-trigger, rep-filter-reset, rep-table, rep-counts; history row shows the just-created log (test.account@example.com → info@listingheds.in with cross-domain badge, manual trigger, 1/1 camps+drips swapped); rep-auto-scan-btn click succeeded; (e) Regression — Forecast, Domain Tracking, Auto-Allocator, Capacity Planner, ReplacementSection all still render on /infrastructure with no new JS errors. Seed data cleaned up post-run (campaigns / drips / sessions / replacements / status restored).

integration_issues.issue: rep-recent-list element only renders when there is at least one prior log row (conditional on history.items.length > 0). After our manual replacement completed via the at-risk Replace flow, the ReplacementSection re-fetches counts but the recent-list is rendered inside a conditional that initially showed 'no entries yet' empty state. Once a log row exists in tracked_replacements, the list does appear (verified by reloading /infrastructure after the swap). Not blocking — by design. Just flagging that brief empty-state shows before first refresh on a fresh deployment.

critical_code_review_comments: infra_phase_b.py is a clean 306-line single-file module — well under the 700-line guideline. Helpers (_busy_account_ids / _affected_campaigns / _pick_replacement / _swap_in_collections / _log_replacement) are properly async, exclude Mongo _id, and respect role-based scoping (is_admin sees all, others restricted to user_id).

_pick_replacement excludes Warming Up status (good — those should not be promoted to replacements), excludes remaining_capacity<=0, and sorts by (cross_domain_desc, -remaining_capacity, -daily_limit). Deterministic and matches the spec.
_swap_in_collections de-duplicates ids after swap (defensive against a replacement already being present — though _pick_replacement filters busy out, so it shouldn't happen). Good safety net.
execute() logs no_candidate before raising HTTPException 409, then returns the log inside the exception detail — clients can show toast even when no replacement was found. Good UX shape.
InfrastructureReplacements.jsx (~290 LOC) is a focused single-page component with all 7 required testids. Filter Select + Reset work via local state.

Infrastructure.jsx now ~2580 lines (ReplacementSection added ~110 LOC). The 700-line refactor backlog flagged in iter-55/56 is still pending — Phase B adds another section inline. Strongly recommend splitting into /pages/infrastructure/{Forecast,DomainTracking,Allocator,Planner,Replacements}.jsx before Phase C.

All testids use kebab-case as specified; row testids use both rep-row-replace-<account_id> (in the at-risk Replace links) and rep-row-rep_<replacement_id> (in the history table) — naming is consistent.
